newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX oil prices steady, crude fails at resistance.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX oil prices steady, crude fails at resistance.

text.p: NYMEX oil prices were firm but off from their highs Wednesday afternoon after prompt crude failed at technical resistance.
"Crude is off from its high because it failed once again at $22.75," said Tom Bentz, analyst with ING Derivatives in New York. March crude was 19 cents higher at $22.71 a barrel.
The market's reaction was muted to news China's top leader Deng Xiaoping died Wednesday at the age of 93.
"There is no governmental unrest seen as a result of his death, so there is no fundamnental change for oil prices to move on," said Bentz.
China's official Xinhua news agency said Xiaoping died of complications from Parkinson's disease and a lung infection. China is a key part of Asia's growing demand for oil, analysts said.
